title: Torque
content: The magnitude of the moment of force (or) torque is defined as the product of the force and the perpendicular distance from the line of action of the force to the fulcrum[cite: 1].

title: Moment of Inertia
content: The moment of inertia of an object is defined as the sum of the products obtained by multiplying the mass of each particle in a given object and the square of its distance from the axis[cite: 1].

title: Angular Momentum
content: The angular momentum of an object is defined as the product of its moment of inertia and angular velocity[cite: 1].

title: Centre of Gravity
content: The centre of gravity of a particular object is a point at which all its weight may be considered to act[cite: 1].
